translations: Indeed, I [I] put my trust upon
Allah my Lord and your Lord
(There is) not of a moving creature of a moving creature
of its forelock Indeed my Lord
puzzle.hint: A powerful verse about divine guidance — the Prophet cannot guide whom he loves; only Allah guides whom He wills.
puzzle.arabic: إِنِّى تَوَكَّلْتُ عَلَى ٱللَّهِ رَبِّى وَرَبِّكُم ۚ مَّا مِن دَآبَّةٍ إِلَّا هُوَ ءَاخِذٌۢ بِنَاصِيَتِهَآ ۚ إِنَّ رَبِّى عَلَىٰ صِرَٰطٍۢ مُّسْتَقِيمٍۢ
puzzle.verseEn: Indeed, I have relied upon Allāh, my Lord and your Lord. There is no creature but that He holds it by its forelock [i.e., controls it]. Indeed, my Lord is on a path [that is] straight.
